newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q1 HOUSING STARTS UP 55 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q1 HOUSING STARTS UP 55 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The volume of Finnish home building starts in January-March rose 55 percent year-on-year to a total of 1.5 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.
The volume of all building starts in the first quarter rose just one percent year-on-year to a total of 3.6 million cubic metres, SF said.
The number of housing starts rose 44 percent in January-March on the year-ago period to a total of 4,700 starts, SF said.

The volume of industrial and warehouse building starts was unchanged at 0.92 million cubic metres, while the volume of commercial and office building starts fell 32 percent, and the volume of public building starts fell 69 percent, SF said.
Agricultural building starts more than doubled in volume in January-March year-on-year to a total of 0.33 million cubic metres, SF said.
